limitations: One small GA run, not a sweep or general performance claim.
Training candidates see different maps because seeds depend on population index.
Automatic post-training evaluation overlaps training seeds and is excluded from the reported comparison.
Terminal-reason JSON counts are used; the standalone text timeout counter double-counts runner timeouts.
CSV rewards and JSON averages are rounded to four decimal places by the CLI.
Scripted and heuristic are behaviorally equivalent here, not independent algorithmic baselines.
Per-episode CSV records reward and length, not terminal reasons; outcome totals come from raw aggregate JSON.
The replay is illustrative heuristic play, not trained neuro play, and requires the native project viewer.
Native visual playback requires --seed 20360918; the viewer does not restore the recording seed automatically.
Per-episode seed metadata is derived from the declared CLI sequence, not independently emitted by the runner.
